message: 帰りたくない

name: Melilot
message: 「She hasn't come by today either」

name: Synn
message: 「I... see」
Could it be... just like everyone said, she's seriously avoiding me.

name: Synn
message: 「Um」

name: Melilot
message: 「Yes, what is it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Did Azel say anything... um, about me or anything?」

name: Melilot
message: 「No. Nothing at all」
Until just a little while ago, whenever I came to pick her up, Azel would put on a grumpy face, yet still look happy.
She'd stopped complaining when we walked home together, showing her happiness in her own clumsy way.
I thought things were going well.
Even after that rainy night, when things ended up like that.
We were both embarrassed, yet even so, she never avoided me.

name: Melilot
message: 「Do you have any idea what might have caused this?」

name: Synn
message: 「......No, I don't」
I wanted to see her terribly.
Ever since the day Nanaka confessed to me, I haven't seen her at all.
Even though it's only been three days. Even though she was a girl who wasn't even in my life three months ago.

name: Melilot
message: 「Was Lady Azel acting strangely at all?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, she wasn't......」

name: Melilot
message: 「He has gone home.」

name: Azel
message: 「......Thank you」

name: Melilot
message: 「Are you sure about this?」
Azel kept staring intently at the cup of black tea placed before her.

name: Azel
message: 「This... is the right thing......」

name: Melilot
message: 「Right for whom, exactly?」

name: Azel
message: 「I am merely following the will of the Lord」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is it what's right for you, Azel-san?」

name: Azel
message: 「I believe in the word of the Lord. All devout people do. Even those who are not devout ought to」

name: Azel
message: 「The Lord is always right. Righteousness is with the Lord. Nowhere else. Everything must be according to the Lord's will」
Having declared that all in one breath, Azel gulped down the rest of his black tea.

name: Melilot
message: 「Are you saying your heart must be one with God's will, Azel-san?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Yes. That is how it must be」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is avoiding Sakura-kun also God's will?」

name: Azel
message: 「It is」

name: Melilot
message: 「Even if it hurts Sakura-kun?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Synn is... only suffering on his own accord. It has... nothing to do with me」
Azel raised his tea to his lips again, only to find the cup empty.

name: Melilot
message: 「Then where is your heart, Azel-san?」

name: Azel
message: 「My heart is with the righteousness of the Lord」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then why do you watch him from the shadows until he leaves the library?」

name: Azel
message: 「That's, because, I--」
Suddenly clutching his chest, Azel lost his balance and toppled over backward, chair and all.

name: Azel
message: 「Ugh. Nngh--!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Azel-san!?」

name: Azel
message: 「It's... nothing」

name: Melilot
message: 「There's no way it's nothing!」

name: Azel
message: 「It's nothing... If I just stay quiet for a bit, it'll pass...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'm contacting Sakura-kun」

name: Azel
message: 「Stop!」
Melilot's hand froze just as he reached for his phone.

name: Azel
message: 「Please... don't tell anyone... Especially not Synn...」
With a sigh, Melilot put her phone away.

name: Melilot
message: 「Understood. However, if you don't at least get in touch with him, he'll worry.」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't... want to go back there.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Depending on the situation, that's quite a suggestive line.」

name: Azel
message: 「Suggestive...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Just for today.」

name: Azel
message: 「What is...?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I can't very well throw you out onto the street in that condition. Please stay at my place tonight.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Is that okay?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I'll tell him that you came by after Sakura-kun left, and while we were talking about the photos, it got late so you ended up staying at my place.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Please do.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, understood... Please take good care of Azel.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's up?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's Azel. He says he's staying at Melilot-san's place tonight」

name: Paqy
message: 「Man, he's seriously avoiding you」

name: Paqy
message: 「Taejun!?」
I have no idea.
Since when has he been avoiding me?
Since when did we stop talking?
Since the morning of the day Nanaka confessed to me.
No, that's not it.
It's been since that lunch break when Nanaka and Azel disappeared together.
